purpose: Implement the separate learning/collaboration-depth dimension DO IT / WITH ME / SHOW ME / EXPLAIN WHY / LET ME TRY on the normal Song Learning journey without conflating it with ASK/ADVISE/TRY/DO authority or granting execution permission.

lineage.outcome: The artist can choose how much agency N0TE should take for one real Song-learning job, receiving behavior that clearly leads, collaborates, demonstrates, explains, or stands back without changing action authority.
lineage.capability: Interaction depth independent from mutation authority

why_now: REQ-SCOPE-124 is explicitly mapped to UX-01 and is a REQUIRED MINIMUM Gate-B blocker on Song / Produce / Learn. Repairing the governance workflow exposed that SONG-01 had been activated while its UX-01 dependency remained open. Rather than falsely close UX-01 or weaken dependency checks, this already-selected customer outcome is reparented to its canonical UX-01 node, whose APP-01/CORE-02/CORE-03 dependencies are DONE.
completion_proof: all five canonical interaction-depth modes are first-class and consumer-reachable for a real current open Song Learning episode
mode choice is a per-job request, not silently stored as permanent Artist preference, taste doctrine or Skill evidence
DO IT requests maximum N0TE agency but never grants authority, eligibility, capability, approval or execution and reports truthful blocked/authority-required semantics when execution is not bound
WITH ME divides the current bounded job into explicit N0TE and artist steps
SHOW ME gives a concrete read-only BEFORE -> proposed change -> AFTER walkthrough without claiming the project was modified
EXPLAIN WHY uses represented consequence evidence/source/confidence plus bounded-variable reasoning and causal humility
LET ME TRY leaves the action to the artist and positions N0TE for observation/feedback rather than mutation
interaction planning binds the exact active Song, exact current open Learning episode and the evidence/decision state rendered to the artist so stale plans fail closed
consumer mode selection does not mutate Song, Version, Session, Learning evidence/decision, Skill state, Focus, authority, DAW, provider or durable preference state
internal Song/Learning/Session/source-reference identities remain out of visible browser markup
Origin, CSRF and one-shot replay protections apply to the mode-selection POST
GET remains durable-pure and authored tests remain separate from executed evidence
repository governance workflow instantiates and executes Ubuntu, Windows and macOS jobs and records exact-head status evidence
active graph/current state obey the real completion dependency order without falsely marking unfinished UX-01 scope DONE
